# 1281. Subtract the Product and Sum of Digits of an Integer

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(n))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def subtractProductAndSum(self, n):
        """
        :type n: int
        :rtype: int
        """
        ans1, ans2 = 0, 1
        for c in str(n):
            ans1 += int(c)
            ans2 *= int(c)
        return ans2 - ans1
```
